notes:
Topline: evaluation focused on multilingual RAG + lightweight reranking.  Primary ask: high recall across 10+ languages with per-language tuning and predictable cost/latency.

Background: startup spun out of a translation tech research group. They run search across product docs, legal, and user-generated content in EN/FR/DE/ES/PT/JA/KO/ZH/AR/HI. Index currently ~120M docs (mix of short messages + long PDFs). Want to scale to 300M+ indexed segments.

Requirements summary:
- Retrieval latency target: median <150ms for initial embedding-based ANN fetch (p99 under 400ms).
- End-to-end (retrieval + rerank) SLO: average query <350ms, p95 <800ms for EU region.
- Cost sensitivity: looking to keep cost/query < $0.008 for typical 3-step flow (embed+retrieve+rerank).
- Per-language recall/precision tuning: must be able to run language-specific recall tests, swap embedding models per-language, and A/B reranker configs.
- Models: prefer open models. Interested in multilingual embeddings (SBERT-ms, LASER2) and a compact cross-lingual reranker (flan/mcap-like).
- Routing/fallback: need to fallback to smaller quantized model if Dedicated capacity saturated; also regional fallback to NA for disaster scenarios.
- Security/Compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency, SOC2/ISO27001 required. Air-gapped option desirable for certain legal corpora.

Recent timeline (highlights):
- 2025-10-28: Intro call (AE Diego) — high-level requirements captured.
- 2025-11-04: Deep dive with ML infra + search team (SE Ravi) — handed over current index stats and recall baselines. Fireflies: ff_2025-11-06_vernacular_poc_call.
- 2025-11-07: Sent security questionnaire (drive:/security/vernacular_search_labs/security-questionnaire.xlsx).
- 2025-11-10: Pricing/architecture sync: want Dedicated for predictable latency and Private for legal corpora.
- 2025-11-14: Internal legal flagged residency clause; cost committee requested per-query TCO model.

POC scope (agreed):
- Index ~50M representative segments across 6 languages (EN/FR/DE/ES/ZH/JA).
- Run recall sweep: baseline vs SBERT-ms vs custom fine-tuned embedder.
- Implement a lightweight transformer reranker on top of nearest neighbors for top-100 candidates.
- Collect per-language precision/recall + latency, token cost breakdown, and cost per query report.

- "If Dedicated reduces variability and keeps costs predictable we can greenlight." — CTO.
